editions.change: First full structure locked — the design calls that became the draft's spine: landlord-paid, experience-rated premium; no subrogation; independent claims adjudication with a tenant counter-claim lane; tenant and consumer seats on the governing board; manufactured-claim penalties; sunset with a year-3 report.
Naming locked: the model is Turnbuchalla; the statute is the Minnesota Rent Assurance & Deposit Protection Act; presented by Semptify.

Funding model resolved — the deposit goes into bonded program escrow at signing and the landlord never holds it; year one carried by escrow float, the ongoing share by the MN Renter's Credit. Third coverage leg added: renter's personal-belongings coverage rides the same pool.

Funding braid merged to three sources — escrow float, Renter's Credit assignment, and an explicit landlord matched share. Fairness axiom locked: nobody gets hurt — landlord-side and tenant-side abuse controls must be equally real. Belongings coverage shape deferred to post-actuarial.

Hole-audit remediation: deposit stays in custodial escrow for the tenancy (UK custodial model) with an annual float dividend replacing the clean-year refund; rating resolved as community-rated base plus bounded experience surcharge; landlord no-claim dividend added. Float math corrected to 3% net of escrowed deposits.
Model renamed Turnbucapp to Turnbuchalla; the old spelling kept only as an internal alias.
Titled restructure — the draft reorganized into Titles I through IV (deposit protection, rent assurance, belongings, governance). This became the public read-through text.

One live bill — versions abolished; BILL_LIVE.md is the only draft and the public read-through is generated from it. First public parchment published: the bill, the Inkwell, the Public Record, References, Supporters.
Title I rendered as a formal amendatory act against Minn. Stat. § 504B.178 — statutory language prepared for outside-counsel redline.
